title: Catching
caption: W-shape and chest catch
b1: For a ball above the chest, the hands make a W-shape: thumbs close together behind the ball, fingers spread. Catch it in front of you, where your eyes can see it.
b2: For a ball below the waist, the palms face down and the little fingers come together. As soon as it touches your hands, gather it into your chest.
b3: As the ball hits your hands, the elbows bend a little and absorb it — the hands don’t stay stiff. A ball bounces off stiff hands.
t1: Thumbs behind the ball, close together.
t2: Step forward to get your body behind it.
t3: The sound should be soft — a hard sound means hard hands.
